question: First edition of the Youth Olympic Games was held at _________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 1st Summer YOG** was held in **Singapore**, in **August 2010.**
 
• The youth Olympic Games (YOG) is an international multi-sport event for athletes between** 15 and 18 years old**
 
• The YOG was created at the initiative of the former President of the International Olympic Committee (IOC), **Jacques Rogge**.
 
• The **1st Winter YOG** was held in Innsbruck, in January 2012.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2020 Winter Youth Olympic Games were held in **Lausanne**.
 
• The 2024 Winter Youth Olympics will take place in **Gangwon**, South Korea.
 
• The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics will be held in **Dakar**, Senegal.
 
• International Olympic Committee
 
 
• **President** - Thomas Bach
 
• **HQ **- Lausanne, Switzerland
